visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark braided hair wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and a man in a white graphic t-shirt sit on a grey couch. They hold two black containers of 'Ding Bu' pudding against a background with a yellow star-shaped plush toy. A small promotional card is shown, and a tabby cat briefly leaps onto the couch behind them. (2) The woman gestures excitedly toward the camera as colorful confetti graphics burst across the frame. She points to herself and smiles broadly while the man remains seated beside her. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting their facial expressions. (3) The pair opens the black pudding containers. The man uses a yellow plastic spoon to eat the dark-colored pudding, while the woman holds her container and speaks to the camera. They display the texture of the dessert, which appears firm and translucent. (4) They hold the small circular lid of the pudding close to the camera lens to examine the printed text and ingredient list. Their hands are in focus, showing the red and yellow branding on the foil lid. (5) The woman continues talking while holding the pudding container and a blue plastic spoon. The man tastes more of the pudding, looking contemplative. They are positioned in a medium close-up, with the grey couch and living room wall visible in the background. (6) The video transitions to show a screen capture of a previous video about cilantro cookies. The woman claps her hands and laughs heartily, leaning toward the man. She ends the video with a high-energy gesture and a wink toward the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech introduces the 'Ding Bu' pudding over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM. A 'boing' SFX triggers as graphics appear. (2) A series of rapid thudding sounds are heard, described by the speakers as a cat scratching a box. The male voice interjects with a questioning tone. (3) A distinct 'pop' and crinkling sound of plastic foil being peeled open occurs as the characters open the containers. (4) Wet slurping and smacking sounds follow as the male speaker tastes the pudding directly from the lid. The background music maintains a constant high-tempo beat. (5) Scraping sounds of plastic spoons against the bottom of the containers accompany the dialogue about flavor profiles. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into a segment with loud, synchronized laughter and rhythmic hand clapping from both speakers. (7) The video ends with a final high-pitched exclamation from the woman and a quick fade of the BGM.
